name: aira
description: Aira — AI maternal-wellness companion. Monorepo: web + admin + backend.
comment: Deliberately NOT an npm workspace, and this package has no dependencies of
its own — it is a task runner.
apps/web ships a self-contained Sites toolchain (scripts/sites-env.sh,
install-ci.sh, build-verified.sh) that pins its own npm cache under
.sites-runtime, runs `npm ci` against its OWN package-lock.json, and resolves
node_modules/.bin/vinext relative to the app directory. Declaring workspaces
here hoisted every dependency to the repo root, so that binary was never
where the build script looked and `npm run build` failed with 'vinext is
unavailable'. Each app installs independently instead, which is also what

scripts.install:all: npm run install:web && npm run install:admin
